svg.title: We specify the finite expression prescription, including its recursion. A score is a finite sum of field expressions tensored with linear operations on smooth tests; its action at x multiplies the field expression at x by the operated test at x. Products compose test instructions in their prescribed order. For disjoint label groups those instructions commute, by orthogonality of their normal spaces. Let Cg denote the recursively constructed local correction, and let Pg be the punctured score formed from proper partitions: X Y Pg = Ci. i∈Q
